name: Rumpa Ray-Ghosh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rumpa Ray-Ghosh is a poet whose work also includes teaching, educational writing and curriculum development. Her contributor biography in Our Poetry Archive describes an interest in singing alongside these activities. She co-authored Musical Marvels of Self with Ujjwala Kakarla in 2017, a collaboration Kakarla recalls in an account published by Zorba Books.

Hope moves through the landscapes of her poems here. In “Gust of Hope”, fields, paths and forests give changing forms to uncertainty and resilience. “Lent me a feather” turns an encounter with a travelling bird into an image of shared courage: one life offering another the means to endure a storm and imagine a further flight.
